shots.text: Under Grundhallow the Mountain Titan fell, a giant of grey stone. The grey came off it like dust, and under it was Orrok.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Titan crashing down; grey lichen falling from its eyes; amber geode eyes opening. Orrok.

shots.speaker: orrok
shots.art_note: Orrok, enormous, looking at the towers.

shots.text: It was the first thing he had said in two thousand years. The storm left the canyon, and the Stoneborn buried their dead in the Deep Halls.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The great stone doors of Grundhallow closing on the dead, torches along the hall.

shots.text: That's the last ring. Hear me say it. No more.
shots.speaker: gorrim
shots.art_note: Gorrim braiding one more iron ring into his beard.
